name: Komodo National Park
description: Komodo National Park is a cluster of rugged volcanic islands in Indonesia's Lesser Sunda chain, and it is the only place on Earth where Komodo dragons live in the wild. About 5,700 of these giant, aggressive lizards roam its dry, golden hillsides. Below them, white beaches meet coral-rich waters that are part of the Coral Triangle, among the most biodiverse seas anywhere.
